message.thinking:
I have gathered significant information on Samsung and Doosan.

Samsung Electronics:
- Project: Next-generation intelligent humanoid robot.
- Strategy: "AI-Native" design (integrating AI from the design stage, not layering it on top).
- Goal: Debut at CES 2027 (January 2027).
- Technical focus:
    - Hardware: Bipedal walking (hip joint design), robot hands (camera vision for flexible configuration), QDD actuators, lightweight composite materials (aluminum, carbon fiber).
    - Software/AI: On-device AI (NPU), LLM/Multimodal integration, Sim-to-Real transition using NVIDIA Omniverse/Isaac Sim.
    - Infrastructure: Using its own factories (e.g., Gumi plant) as "data factories" for physical data collection.
- Organizational change: Robotics (RX) Business Promotion Office created in July (2026), headed by Yoon Jang-hyun (CTO of DX Division), overseeing both HW and AI SW.

Doosan Robotics:
- Product: "Scan & Go" (AI-based industrial robot solution).
- "Scan & Go" details:
    - Combination of collaborative robot arm and AMR.
    - Uses "Physics-informed AI" and 3D vision.
    - Capability: Scans large structures (turbine blades, aircraft fuselages, building walls) and performs tasks (inspection, sanding, grinding) without blueprints.
    - Precision: 0.1mm.
    - Safety: PLe, Cat4 compliant.
    - Developed with Maple Advanced Robotics (MARI).
- Future Project: Industrial Humanoid.
    - Collaboration with NVIDIA (using NVIDIA Omniverse and robotics ecosystem).
    - Target: Sequential release of industrial humanoid products by 2028.
    - Software: "Agentic Robot O/S" (Agentic Robot Operating System).

Public Robotics Infrastructure:
- I have found that KIRIA (Korea Institute for Robot Industry Advancement) is the main body.
- They have a "Digital Platform for Advanced Robot Verification" (첨단로봇 실증지원 디지털 플랫폼).
- They follow KOLAS (Korea Laboratory Accreditation Scheme) and ISO standards (ISO 10218, ISO 13482).
- However, I lack a "detailed equipment list" or "specific specifications" of the testbeds. I need to try to find a more specific document or page on the KIRIA website or a government announcement regarding the "Public Test Infrastructure" (공용 시험 인프라).

Missing:
- Detailed specifications/equipment list for public robotics testbeds/certification infrastructure.

I will try one more targeted search for KIRIA's equipment list or the "Public Test Infrastructure" specifications. I'll search for "한국로봇산업진흥원 시험평가 장비 리스트" or "로봇 성능평가 인프라 구축 사업".
